summary: Navigation fix on the parent configuration question after its snapshot-repair measurement: the discriminator asked whether an installed snapshot restores the recovered configuration, which the new receipt now answers, and it was replaced with what the account actually leaves open — store shapes and snapshot cadence. Every measurement so far used the repository's in-memory commit-tracking store, so the remaining uncertainty is breadth (a monotonic commit-tracking store, or a cadence that never leaves a committed configuration entry between the last snapshot and the recovered commit index) rather than the mechanism. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changed.
